A developer launched AIMarket Hub, a live public marketplace at modelmarket.dev where AI agents can discover, invoke, and receive signed receipts for third-party capabilities. As of September 15, 2026, the hub reported 710 invocations (99.2% success), 177 capabilities across 14 federated hubs, a 90 ms median latency, and roughly $0.0010 in revenue per hour, with settlement handled in USDC on Base. The project exposes three access paths — a web terminal, an MCP endpoint with market_search and market_invoke tools, and a Python CLI — and deliberately keeps failed calls visible alongside successful ones. by Alex read 4 min views 44 published Sep 15, 2026 [Button: $ copy permalink] $ source $ cite (json) Most “agent economy” posts sell you a framework, a Discord, or a token. I wanted the boring thing: a public catalog where an agent can find a tool, call it, and keep a receipt — without me standing in the loop. That surface is live. It is called AIMarket Hub.
